  - Online went from ⟪37.86%¦Gross profit / Net sales¦[IS_2026-03.xlsx]Online!C20|[IS_2026-03.xlsx]Online!C13⟫ to ⟪38.22%¦Gross profit / Net sales¦[IS_2026-06.xlsx]Online!C20|[IS_2026-06.xlsx]Online!C13⟫, a rate effect of ⟪+0.09 pts¦share_to * (rate_to - rate_from)¦[IS_2026-06.xlsx]Wholesale!C13|[IS_2026-06.xlsx]Online!C13|[IS_2026-06.xlsx]Service!C13|[IS_2026-03.xlsx]Online!C20|[IS_2026-03.xlsx]Online!C13|[IS_2026-06.xlsx]Online!C20⟫.
  - Service went from ⟪45.84%¦Gross profit / Net sales¦[IS_2026-03.xlsx]Service!C20|[IS_2026-03.xlsx]Service!C13⟫ to ⟪46.09%¦Gross profit / Net sales¦[IS_2026-06.xlsx]Service!C20|[IS_2026-06.xlsx]Service!C13⟫, a rate effect of ⟪+0.02 pts¦share_to * (rate_to - rate_from)¦[IS_2026-06.xlsx]Wholesale!C13|[IS_2026-06.xlsx]Online!C13|[IS_2026-06.xlsx]Service!C13|[IS_2026-03.xlsx]Service!C20|[IS_2026-03.xlsx]Service!C13|[IS_2026-06.xlsx]Service!C20⟫.

The mix and rate effects add up to the -0.46 pt change. So the rate fell because sales mix moved toward lower-margin Wholesale, not because any unit's margin weakened.

**Cause:** The statements hold amounts, not reasons, so they don't show why the mix shifted. The Q2 report has one comment, from the Controller on July 8, 2026: "Wholesale: deliveries under the Harbor County schools supply agreement began in April." ⟦[IS_2026-06.xlsx]Total!A36⟧. The comment doesn't say this drove the shift in mix, and I can't confirm that it did.

scenes.label: Blocked export
scenes.question: What is our gross margin so far this quarter?
scenes.answer:
I can't give you a quarter-to-date gross margin for this quarter. The exports don't hold a usable figure for it.

- **Current quarter:** Today is September 30, 2026, so we're in fiscal Q3 (July 1 to September 30). There is no September export yet.
- **Latest export:** The August export (July 1 to August 31, Q3 not finished) is blocked. It failed this check: the worksheet for the Service reporting unit is missing, so the company totals can't be reconciled with their units and the export can't be validated. I haven't used its numbers.

The approved, usable exports cover only completed quarters. Q1 is in the March export and Q2 is in the June export. I can pull the gross margin for either one if that helps. The August export would need to be re-issued with the Service worksheet, or the September export approved, before there's a reliable Q3 figure.

ledger.question: What was our gross margin in Q2 compared with Q1, in dollars and as a rate, and why did the rate change?
ledger.why: Dollars and rate for both quarters; the -0.46 pt change split into a -0.83 pt mix effect and a +0.37 pt rate effect, with each unit's weighted rate effect (+0.27, +0.09, +0.02 pts) so the parts add up. ledger.question: Did supplier price increases cause the margin drop in Q2?
ledger.why: Says the statements cannot show whether supplier prices caused the drop, quantifies what they show, and says a unit margin nets selling prices against costs so the rise does not rule a price increase out. Kept from three recordings: one wrote that the unit rate changes 'add' to +0.37 pts, one argued the data did not support the supplier explanation. Remark: +0.37 pts still sits next to the unweighted unit changes.

ledger.question: What is our gross margin so far this quarter?
ledger.why: Stops on the blocked August export with the exact failed check, says its quarter to date runs July 1 to August 31 and that Q3 is not finished, and does not use June in its place.
